resources.string: Camouflage to sneakily get around and gather info!
Use your Camouflage ability to turn invisible and gather information.

The Chameleon is a Crewmate Investigative role that can use their ability to temporarily turn invisible to all other players. During the time that they are invisible, the Chameleon will get a speed boost, and if settings allow, the ability to vent. Idea by mystic_haze2
Camouflage to turn invisible. While invisible, you gain a speed boost and will be able to vent if settings allow.
Complete tasks to reveal the letters of players' roles.
Complete tasks to reveal letters of the roles that players spawned with, and decrypt the scrambled codes.

The Decryptor is a Crewmate Investigative role that can complete tasks to slowly reveal the letters in players' original roles. If settings allow, evils may be alerted of the Decryptor's presence. The Decryptor only decrypts the roles players spawned into the game with, not necessarily what they currently are.
You have revealed a letter of everyone's role!
The Decryptor is finding out your true identity, stop them!
Evils now know of your presence!
Number Of Tasks For Letter Reveal
Number Of Letters Revealed For Evil Alert
Check player's roles and reveal them.
Inspect players during the meeting, then reveal them if you know their roles!
The Inspector is a Crewmate Investigative role that can Inspect players during the meeting to see if they are a certain role. If they are correct, they can publish their role for everyone to see.
Inspect a player during the meeting to check if they are a certain role with a guesser menu.
Reveal the role of a player that you successfully inspected to everyone. This does not reveal alliance modifiers.
[player] does not seem to be the [role].
[player] appears to be the [role]! You can now publish your results about them.
Can Inspect Same Person Again In Same Round
Can Inspect Same Role Again In Same Round
Kill players who are opposed to your Juror.
Recruit a Juror and bring judgement to their enemies!

The Magistrate is a Crewmate Power role that can recruit a player every round to be a Juror. The Magistrate can then bring judgement to any player in the meeting except the Juror. If the player is an enemy of the Juror, they will die. If they are an ally of the Juror, the Magistrate will die.
Enlist a player to be your Juror for the next meeting.
Judge a player in the meeting, if they are enemies with your Juror they will be executed. If they are friends with your Juror, then you will be executed.
You decided to enlist [player] for your trial in [seconds] seconds...
[player] was successfully enlisted for your next trial!
You instead decided not to enlist.
The Magistrate chose you to be their Juror!
The Magistrate chose you to compare your alliance with another player in the next meeting!
[player] was unable to be judged! They are either blessed or are immune.
Get More Judgement Uses From Tasks
Identify the roles in play to start a protest and win the game!
During the meeting, identity and rally crewmate roles in the game correctly to start a protest. Survive the protest to win!

The Pacifist is a Crewmate Power role that can win the game for crewmates by successfully identifying what crewmate roles are in the game during the meeting. Doing so successfully will start a protest, and if you survive until the end of the next meeting, crewmates will win! During the final meeting, only the Pacifist and their enemies may vote.
Rally crewmate roles during the meeting. If all roles that you have chosen are in the game, you will start a protest.
Rally crewmate roles during the meeting. If all roles that you have chosen are in the game, you will start a protest.
You have successfully started a protest!
The Pacifist has started a protest, stop them before the next meeting or else the crewmates will win!
Your rally has failed. At least one role was incorrect.
Your rally has failed. [number] roles were not identified successfully.
Number Of Roles Needed To Protest

Protect your target at all costs!
Kill the first person who interacts with the target you sanctified.
Choose a target to sanctify. You will kill the next person to interact with them if they are interacted with.

The Crusader is a Crewmate Protective role that can choose a player to sanctify on their menu. The chosen player will be fortified for a certain amount of time, and the Crusader will kill the first person to interact with them if they are interacted with.
Choose a player to sanctify, killing the next playerto interact with them while they are sanctified.
Manipulate votes and reveal yourself for political immunity.
During the meeting, you can manipulate votes and reveal for voting immunity.

The Diplomat is an Impostor Power role that can manipulate the meeting. They can choose a player to manipulate, making them vote for the player the player the Diplomat voted for. They can also reveal themselves for political immunity, which also gives the Diplomat the ability to manipulate two players at a time. However, they will leave the game after a certain number of meetings after revealing.
Choose a person during the meeting to manipulate, swapping their vote to what you voted. If you are revealed, you can manipulate two players at a time.

Reveal yourself to all players, giving you political immunity for the meeting while also increasing your kill cooldown and buffing your manipulation ability. You will leave a certain number of rounds after you reveal.
You need to get [required] more kill(s) to reveal!
You will leave the game after [meetings] meetings!
You will leave the game at the end of this meeting!
Meetings Diplomat Has Before Leaving Post-Reveal
Every kill you get, a random sabotage is called.
Call sabotages when you kill bodies. Sabotages can stack, and your kill cooldown is faster during sabotages.
The Disruptor is an Impostor Power role that can kill to call a random sabotage. Sabotages can stack on top of each other. Their kill cooldown is lower during sabotages.
Kidnap players and exterminate high-value targets.
Kidnap players to jail them next meeting. They will see that they were jailed by the Jailor.

The Kidnapper is an Impostor Power role that can kidnap players into the meeting. Kidnapped players will appear to be jailed by the Jailor, and you will appear as a Jailor to them. You have a one-time execute button to kill a kidnapped player.
Inspect a player during the meeting to check if they are a certain role with a guesser menu.
Kill the currently kidnapped player. You can only do this once.
Unstoppable attack meets immovable object! [player] cannot be executed! They must be Invulnerable or blessed! You can no longer exterminate.
[player] was successfully exterminated! You can no longer exterminate.
[player] was successfully exterminated! You can no longer kidnap players.
Get More Kidnap Uses From Kills
Bodies you kill are jinxed and deadly for a while.
Jinx bodies you kill, making them deadly for a while.

The Jinx is an Impostor Killing role whose bodies will kill whoever reports them for a short time. Sparkles on a body are a visual indicator that it is deadly to report. The Jinx can also choose a player to jinx during the meeting, making the first person to interact with that player to die with a jinxed body.
Choose a person during the meeting to jinx, killing the first person to interact with them the next round with a jinxed body.
You were jinxed by the Jinx! The first person to interact with you will die.
Can Get More Jinx Uses From Kills
Use blood rituals to guess players' roles at no cost.
Preform blood rituals to guess roles at no cost to you.

The Ritualist is an Impostor Killing role that can attempt to guess the roles of players during the round using blood rituals. The Ritualist will know if they are right or wrong about their guess, and they won't have any punishment on misguessing. If they are right, their role will be visible to all impostors and the Ritualist can eliminate the revealed player during the meeting. Elimnating a player will always use the RHM meeting death animation.
Preform a blood ritual, attempting to guess a player's role at no cost to yourself. If you are correct, their role will be visible to all impostors and you can eliminate them.
Kill a player who was successfully blood-ritualized. Only the Ritualist can do this to a ritualized player.
Your ritual failed. [player] does not seem to be the [role]!
Your ritual succeeded! You can now eliminate the player in the meeting.
[player] could not be eliminated! They must be blessed or immune.
Can Get More Jinx Uses From Kills
Screech to deafen players near you and debuff them temporarily.
Screech to deafen and lower the vision and speed of players nearby. Echo to locate players.

The Banshee is an Impostor Support role that can screech to deafen all unimmune players around them as well as debuff their vision and speed temporarily. They can also use their echo ability to locate where players are.
Deafen and temporarily debuff all players nearby. Deafened players cannot hear/see any messages in chat the next meeting. They will be immune to being deafened again after being deafened.
Locate where people are on the map.
You were deafened by a Banshee and cannot hear/see others messages!
Your ears are now immune to being deafened for [number] round(s).
Screech to deafen players near you and debuff them temporarily.
Screech to deafen and lower the vision and speed of players nearby. Echo to locate players.

The Banshee is an Impostor Support role that can screech to deafen all unimmune players around them as well as debuff their vision and speed temporarily. They can also use their echo ability to locate where players are.
Deafen and temporarily debuff all players nearby. Deafened players cannot hear/see any messages in chat the next meeting. They will be immune to being deafened again after being deafened.
Locate where people are on the map.
You were deafened by a Banshee and cannot hear/see others messages!
Your ears are now immune to being deafened for [number] round(s).
Starbind players who interact with the person you isolated.
Use your Isolate and Daybreak abilities to starbind players.

The Starspawn is a Neutral Outlier role that must starbind a certain number of unique roles. They can isolate players to starbind whoever interacts with that player, and they can use use their Daybreak ability to starbind all players who vote for them in the meeting. The Starspawn can see the roles that are starbound.
Choose a player to isolate, starbinding any player who interacts with your target and canceling any type of interaction.
Daybreak once a game during the meeting to starbind all players who vote for you.
You need [number] unique roles starbounded to win.

Remove button uses from others with every kill you get.
Every kill you get, you passively remove a random non-impostor's ability to button.
